channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FAA proposes inspections of passenger seats on hundreds of Boeing jets
item.description: According to regulators, some seats on certain 737 Max models may have been installed incorrectly. They added this issue could pose potential safety risks during an emergency landing or evacuation.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa police officer dismissed after internal review of body-cam footage uncovers 'repeated violations': TPD
item.description: Tampa Police Department said it has relieved a15-year officer at TPD for "repeated violations" of its policies and procedures.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wildfires force mass evacuations in France as flames produce their own weather
item.description: Wildfires in southwestern France have forced more than 200,000 people to evacuate. The largest blaze near Bordeaux is bigger than Atlanta and has created France's first ever fire cloud.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Apple unveils subscription-style leasing for iPhones and Macs
item.description: Apple is launching a new leasing program for iPhones, Macs and other devices, offering monthly payment plans starting at about $18.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Johnson & Johnson proposes $5.5 billion settlement to end marathon legal fight
item.description: Johnson & Johnson has agreed to pay $5.5 billion to tie up remaining lawsuits that claim its talc products caused ovarian cancer.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Newly released Biden audio recordings include references to ‘classified’ material and struggles with memory
item.description: Audio recordings of former President Joe Biden speaking with his biographer have been released, appearing to support Robert Hur's 2024 findings on classified documents and memory concerns.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Pinellas County Board of County Commissioners D-6
item.description: Leading up to the 2026 Florida primary (Aug. 18) and general election (Nov. 3), Tampa Bay 28 contacted qualified candidates in Tampa Bay area races.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa native Deliah Autry-Jones chases Olympic gold as flag football makes its debut in 2028
item.description: Deliah Autry-Jones, a Robinson High School alum and three-time World Championship gold medalist, is pursuing an Olympic roster spot while coaching youth athletes and working as a pediatric physical therapist.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Two children hospitalized after car crashes into Hillsborough County apartment
item.description: A truck crashed into two apartment units in Palm River-Clair Mel on Tuesday morning, sending two children to the hospital in serious condition, officials said.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dad visits Tropicana Field on 30-day MLB stadium tour honoring late son, promoting water safety
item.description: Jonathan St. Clair is visiting all 30 Major League Baseball stadiums in 30 days to honor his late toddler son, Jasper, who died in an accidental drowning 14 years ago, all while raising money and awareness for childhood water safety.
